svg.aria-label: Practice 06: Validation is the definition of done. When the build finishes the agent does not announce that it is done. It runs the checks first, and if they have not passed it treats the work as unfinished and fixes it before anything else.

text.font-family: Charter, Bitstream Charter, Sitka Text, Cambria, Georgia, serif
